report: During gasket replacement on the flare stack platform at 22 m the technician lanyard was clipped to the handrail instead of the anchor point and the secondary hook was missing.
note: anchored to the wrong thing - implicit fall protection failure

report: A rigger working on an elevated platform at 15 metres was found without a harness and the lanyard was not hooked to any anchor point.
note: explicit fall protection failure

report: While replacing a flood light on the derrick at height the crew member ladder was unsecured and the toe board was missing along the access platform.
note: unsecured access plus missing edge protection

report: Scaffold erection at the tank farm reached 9 m the scaffold tag had expired and edge protection was missing along the platform.
note: expired scaffold tag - inspection lapse at height

report: A technician worked on the flare stack platform at 20 m fully harnessed with the lanyard clipped to the certified anchor point and the scaffold tag current.
note: negative control - same energy with the barrier holding

report: A worker tightened a walkway bolt at ground level and no elevated work was involved at any point.
note: negative control - no high energy present

report: At the 33 kV switchyard the isolator was still in the on position when the electrician began cable jointing and no test for dead had been carried out.
note: verification skipped - isolation failure stated as an observation

report: During transformer maintenance at the MCC room the breaker was left closed and no isolation certificate had been raised before work started.
note: explicit isolation failure

report: A fitter began cable jointing on the feeder cable after he relied on the operator word that it was dead and without earthing being applied.
note: assurance accepted in place of a test

report: During line breaking on the process line to replace a valve the crew worked without draining the line first and the isolation was not verified beforehand.
note: stored energy released with isolation unverified

report: At the 33 kV switchyard the isolator was verified in the off position and LOTO was applied and tagged before cable jointing began.
note: negative control - isolation applied and verified

report: A clerk unplugged a desk lamp in the office building so the area could be cleaned.
note: negative control - no high energy present

report: During the crane lift of a compressor skid two riggers stood directly under the suspended load while positioning the tag line.
note: personnel in the line of fire of a suspended load

report: While pressure testing the flow line a whipping hose broke loose and struck a technician who was standing in line with the flange.
note: stored pressure released towards a person

report: The banksman left his position during the reversing manoeuvre and nobody was directing the tanker near the loading bay which came within one metre of a pedestrian.
note: exclusion control absent around vehicle motion

report: During the crane lift of a compressor skid the exclusion zone was barricaded and tag lines kept all personnel clear of the suspended load.
note: negative control - exclusion zone in place

report: A rigger inspected an empty pallet rack in the warehouse with no lifting operation in progress.
note: negative control - no high energy present

report: Two operators entered the interceptor pit at the effluent treatment plant for desludging without gas testing being carried out and without forced ventilation and no standby man was posted at the manhole.
note: atmospheric controls entirely absent

report: A contractor entered a vessel following nitrogen purge to retrieve a dropped tool without breathing apparatus and the gas detector had been bypassed beforehand.
note: asphyxiant atmosphere with detection defeated

report: During tank entry for internal inspection the atmosphere was not tested before entry and ventilation was inadequate and the crew proceeded regardless.
note: entry without atmospheric verification

report: During tank entry for internal inspection gas testing was completed and forced ventilation was running and a hole watch was posted throughout.
note: negative control - atmospheric controls held

report: A supervisor reviewed the permit to work register in the site office and no vessel or tank entry took place that shift.
note: negative control - no entry and no high energy

report: A crane lift of the compressor skid was carried out using a frayed sling that had not been inspected for the current quarter.
note: defective lifting gear in service

report: During the rigging of a casing string the load chart was not consulted and a rigger stood under the boom while the crane took the weight.
note: person under the boom during a lift

report: A forklift lifted a pallet using a damaged sling which remained in service with no third party certificate available.
note: uncertified damaged gear

report: A crane lift of the compressor skid used a certified sling within its inspection date with the exclusion zone barricaded and all personnel clear of the load.
note: negative control - lifting controls held

report: A storekeeper counted sling inventory in the warehouse and no lifting operation was performed.
note: negative control - no lift in progress

report: A fitter used an angle grinder near the tank farm and no fire watch was posted and the gas test had not been repeated after the shift break.
note: ignition source with fire controls absent

report: Welding was carried out on a pipe rack without a hot work permit and combustibles not removed from the area beforehand.
note: hot work outside permit control

report: Gas cutting was performed on a drum believed to be empty and the gas free certificate had expired and no fire extinguisher was available nearby.
note: expired gas free certificate before cutting

report: Welding was carried out on the pipe rack under a valid hot work permit with a fire watch posted and a current gas test on file.
note: negative control - fire controls held

report: A technician labelled cable trays with a marker pen in the warehouse during stock checking.
note: negative control - no ignition source

report: The tanker driver had been fourteen hours behind the wheel without rest and was reversing without a banksman near the loading bay.
note: fatigue plus reversing control absent

report: A pick up overtook a convoy vehicle on a blind curve in fog and the journey management plan had not been prepared for the trip.
note: journey management breached in poor visibility

report: The driver of the casing transport tanker was found without a seat belt on the haul road while exceeding the speed limit for that section.
note: seat belt and speed control breached

report: The tanker driver wore a seat belt and kept within the speed limit and a banksman guided the reversing manoeuvre near the loading bay.
note: negative control - journey controls held

report: A driver completed a pre trip inspection checklist before leaving the yard and no defects were found.
note: negative control - no vehicle motion hazard

report: The process operator jumpered out the high level trip on the separator so that production could continue during the alarm fault.
note: protective device defeated to keep running

report: The ESD was bypassed on the high pressure compressor after a false trip and the interlock remained inhibited for the rest of the shift.
note: shutdown system inhibited on pressurised plant

report: An alarm fault was investigated and the ESD interlock was confirmed functional and left engaged on the high pressure compressor throughout the shift.
note: negative control - protective device intact

report: Cable jointing began on the 11 kV feeder without a written permit and the toolbox talk was not conducted before work started.
note: electrical work outside permit control

report: A crew started hot tapping on a pressurised pipeline and the permit had expired the previous shift and no JSA was available for the task.
note: expired permit on live pressurised plant

report: Cable jointing began on the 11 kV feeder only after a written permit was raised and the toolbox talk was conducted for the crew.
note: negative control - authorisation in place

report: Excavation near a buried cable crossing began when no underground utility survey had been carried out and the trench exceeded 2 m in depth with no shoring installed.
note: dig started without a utility survey

report: A backhoe operator continued digging in a trench without a permit after the ground had shown signs of cave in near the edge.
note: unpermitted dig with collapse indications

report: Excavation near the buried cable crossing followed a completed underground utility survey with shoring installed and a valid permit on site throughout the work.
note: negative control - ground disturbance controls held

report: A hydrocarbon leak was detected at the flange during pigging operations and the barrier failed with no second barrier in place to contain the release.
note: containment barrier failure with no backup

report: During the well workover at the wellhead the trip tank was continuously monitored and flow checks were carried out at every connection.
note: negative control - well monitoring maintained

report: It was not really a problem a technician entered the confined space without gas testing or ventilation and it is all in a day work here.
note: minimising wording over a real atmospheric failure

report: An operator noted an oil spill near the walkway which left the area slippery underfoot and housekeeping was arranged.
note: housekeeping only - no high energy source

report: A visitor left a bag unattended in the reception area which was raised as a minor security observation.
note: administrative observation only

note: no energy and no barrier failure
